title: Matthew Stafford: We have a high ceiling, have to continue raising our floor

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Matthew Stafford: We have a high ceiling, have to continue raising our floor
sources.description: The Rams were among the favorites for Super Bowl LXIII before they traded for Myles Garrett in June and acquiring the defensive player of the year has only pushed expectations for the coming season higher in Los Angeles.
